title: The market and the state: tariffs, central banks and convertibility
goal: Read how the state's role changed in the 1990s, using sin embargo, no obstante and aunque.

items: I can describe the role of the state in the earlier model.
I can say what the reforms did with tariffs, central banks and foreign investment.
I can explain what the convertibility plan of 1991 did in Argentina.
I can contrast two ideas with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque*.
